_comment: Every innerHTML write is flagged: the two dynamic writes (location.hash/search) and the static string alike. They share one message, so the Issues section groups them into a single numbered entry listing all three locations. The trailing innerHTML = "" is an empty clear and is exempt. The outerHTML write and the insertAdjacentHTML() call name different sinks, so they are their own entries: the item is the sink, and grouping per sink keeps each entry's advice about the sink it names.
